# medRxiv

> medRxiv is a free preprint server for medical and life sciences research, enabling rapid sharing and open peer review of manuscripts before formal publication.

medRxiv provides researchers with a manuscript submission and management platform built on Bench>Press infrastructure, supporting ORCiD authentication and user account management for the global research community.

## Key Topics

- manuscript submission
- preprint server
- preprint repository
- account registration
- user authentication
- ORCiD authentication
- research publishing
- submission system
- preprint platform
- user login
- account management
- login portal
- Bench>Press
- HighWire Press
- openRxiv

## Manuscript Submission

- [Submit a Manuscript](https://submit.medrxiv.org/submission/submit): medRxiv manuscript submission portal for preprint publishing
- [Submission Queue Management](https://submit.medrxiv.org/submission/queues): User dashboard for managing manuscript submission queues
- [In-Progress Submissions](https://submit.medrxiv.org/submission/queue?queueName=submission_in_progress): In-progress manuscript submission tracking and management

## Account Management & Authentication

- [Register a New Account](https://submit.medrxiv.org/submission/registration2): Account registration with ORCiD authentication for medRxiv
- [Account Registration Guide](https://submit.medrxiv.org/submission/registration): Guide for creating new medRxiv user accounts via Bench>Press

## Submission History & Tracking

- [View Submission History](https://submit.medrxiv.org/submission/viewhistory?numResults=10&maxResults=13&type=authored&year=all): User submission history and manuscript tracking interface
